gaps: The confirmed context snapshot requirement names POSIX 0700/0600 modes but does not define the equivalent native Windows confidentiality mechanism.
The confirmed migration requirement calls for an independent second walk without defining a structurally independent enumerator that can detect classifier omissions.

The confirmed preservation wording does not distinguish project-owned settings and modified profiles from hash-matching Forge-owned inputs, and does not say whether --force can bypass the clean-target migration boundary.
resolutions: The amended recovery plan defines one portable current-user-only access invariant, POSIX owner/mode/link checks, and an inheritance-disabled native Windows DACL limited to the current user SID with owner/DACL readback before launch and stale cleanup; every unverifiable or broader ACL refuses unchanged.

The amended recovery plan separates per-family discovery/classification from a no-follow raw directory-entry walk over fixed legacy roots and exact parents; the raw walker cannot call the classifiers and complete one-to-one count/classification/digest coverage is rechecked under the same exclusion before any write or pointer commit.

The amended recovery plan makes clean target state mandatory even with --force, preserves dirt through zero-write refusal, preserves project-owned settings plus client-added and client-modified profiles, and permits replacement/deletion only for byte/hash-matching known Forge-owned installed files; unknown or mixed same-name rows are explicitly preserved or invalid.
summary: One fresh requirements cold read ran because the confirmed-spec grounding digest changed after First merged. Its three implementation gaps are resolved in the amended story and Lean task plans without changing the frozen confirmed spec during bootstrap; admitted Lean implementation will update the spec and architecture before shipping.
